description: Use when you need crypto news or crypto market news headlines about a token or the market from recent articles. Do not use for prices, full article text, social media posts or news older than 72 hours. Returns JSON with the latest crypto news headlines from the last 72 hours (title, link, source, time, tone, people and organizations) about bitcoin, ethereum and blockchain news, from the GDELT news graph for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Search.

hours.description: How far back to search, in hours (1-72, default 24)

limit.description: Most articles to return (1-50, default 20), newest first

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

token.description: Narrow to one coin, chain or company, e.g. solana, xrp or coinbase (any crypto news when omitted)

name: blackwood_crypto_news

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Crypto news
